title: Bold bad girl from the town of Mullinga
html_source:
Namely, Milly Bloom.
After the chorus of an anonymous American
song, “Desperado”: “A bold bad man was this
. .. desperado, / From Cripple Creek way
down in . , . Colorado, I And he walked around
like a … big tornado, I And everywhere he
went he gave his war whoop!”
